purpose: bounded evidence shape for CLI registration, iPhone approval, web QR login, and Kyberneterion workflow selection

assertions: the iPhone receives an alternate-screen QR presentation
the raw PISTIS1 transfer is never printed
no CLI command creates trust, a device binding, or a Monas session
no QR, response, reference, credential, or socket path is printed
the operator receives the stable unavailable result before any ceremony is presented
origin and trust words are shown for human comparison
the exact authority descriptor and registration are verified
Face ID or device passcode is required before signing
the private device key remains in Secure Enclave
the browser displays only a redacted challenge and expiry
the iPhone signs only after displaying the exact audience
Monas consumes the response once before issuing a session
the workflow digest is derived from the exact ordered command
the phone displays workflow, resources, and output references
approval is bound to the Kyberneterion audience
a generic login cannot authorise this action

steps.expected: no session, dispatch, workload, or durable mutation
